## 092f409aea2f

**Reproduced defect: declared exact-control domains are not honored.** At generator SHA-256 `02bd6db4868d8aeb15853de6ee94ac900c0dc6ddd42217e0710f7c8e7aa5fe4e`, `AXES` declares `grid_h=4..18`, `grid_w=4..18`, and `n_bridges=1..8`. Yet difficulty `easy` rejects all six endpoint probes in `checks/audit/092f409aea2f/override-contract-current.json`, for example `grid_h=4` with `draw_int('grid_h'): override 4 outside [7, 8]` and `n_bridges=8` with `override 8 outside [2, 2]`. The same probe shows an unknown override key is silently accepted.

The strict audit override checker independently failed on the same source with 7,085 finding rows over 70,110 calls, including 2,760 generation errors, 4,320 self-check failures, one unknown-key finding, three inert-axis findings, and one missing-provenance finding. Full evidence is `checks/audit/092f409aea2f/override/checks/092f409aea2f_audit_override_results.json`; the compact reproducer is `checks/audit/092f409aea2f/reproduce_override_contract.py`.

These calls use endpoints of the generator's own documented domains; they are not hand-constructed grid counterexamples. This target declares no `RULE_HASH`, so the evidence records it as `null`. No patch was made.
